'''Gerald Edwind Fitch''' (born August 12, 1982) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player who last played for [[Regatas Corrientes]] of the [[Liga Nacional de Básquet]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky Wildcats]] and played internationally and in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA).<ref>[https://www.marca.com/2009/05/12/baloncesto/acb/1242144878.html El Tau hace magia: Mickeal obtiene el pasaporte búlgaro y fichan a Gerald Fitch] {{in lang|es}}</ref>

==College career==
Fitch came to Kentucky in 2000 after being named Mr. Basketball in the state of [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]] his senior year at [[Westside High School (Macon, Georgia)|Westside High School]] in [[Macon, Georgia]]. Fitch entered the starting lineup early in his freshman year, and was named to the All-[[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] Freshman Team. Fitch had a successful four years at Kentucky, leading the team to records of 32–4 and 27–5 in his junior and senior years, respectively. His college career ended, however, with a missed shot at the buzzer to seal an upset loss to [[University of Alabama at Birmingham|UAB]] in the second round of the 2004 [[NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Championship|NCAA Tournament]].{{citation needed|date=July 2026}}

==Professional career==
After going undrafted in the [[2004 NBA draft]], Fitch signed with the [[Washington Wizards]] prior to the [[2004-05 NBA season|2004–05 season]]. He received playing time in the preseason, but was cut prior to the start of the regular season. Fitch then spent that season playing overseas in the [[Euroleague]] and the [[Ukrainian Basketball SuperLeague|Ukrainian SuperLeague]].{{citation needed|date=July 2026}}

Prior to the [[2005-06 NBA season|2005–06 season]], Fitch signed with the [[Miami Heat]],<ref>[https://www.nba.com/heat/news/heat_sign_fitch_050812.html HEAT Sign Gerald Fitch]</ref> where he was used as third string [[point guard]] behind [[Jason Williams (basketball, born 1975)|Jason Williams]] and [[Gary Payton]]. At the trade deadline on February 23, 2006, he was shipped to the [[Houston Rockets]] in exchange for [[Derek Anderson (basketball)|Derek Anderson]],<ref>[http://www.nba.com/rockets/news/Fitch_Anderson_Trade-169467-822.html Rockets Acquire Gerald Fitch from Miami]</ref> and waived before ever playing a game for them.{{citation needed|date=July 2026}}

On March 7, 2006, Fitch was assigned to the [[Austin Toros]] of the [[NBA Development League]]. The following season, he played for Turkish team  [[Galatasaray Café Crown]].{{citation needed|date=July 2026}}

On October 1, 2007, the [[Detroit Pistons]] signed Fitch via free agency, but he was eventually released during preseason.{{citation needed|date=July 2026}}

At the end of 2007, he was signed by [[Pallacanestro Cantù]].{{citation needed|date=July 2026}}

On January 25, 2011, he signed with [[Unicaja Málaga]] in Spain until the end of 2011–12 season.<ref>[http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/81727/180/unicaja-adds-scoring-guard-fitch Unicaja adds scoring guard Fitch]</ref><ref>[http://www.sportando.net/eng/europe/spain/28067/unicaja_malaga_confirms_gerald_fitch_for_the_next_season.html Unicaja Malaga confirms Gerald Fitch for the next season]</ref>

For the 2013–14 season he signed with the [[Foshan Long Lions]] of the [[Chinese Basketball Association]].{{citation needed|date=July 2026}}

In March 2014, he signed with [[Mersin Büyükşehir Belediyesi S.K.|Mersin BB]] of Turkey for the rest of the season.<ref>{{cite news|title=Mersin adds Gerald Fitch|url=https://www.tblstat.net/news/38161|newspaper=TBLStat.net|date=March 25, 2014}}</ref>

On February 7, 2016, he signed with the [[Piratas de Quebradillas]] of the [[Baloncesto Superior Nacional]].<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/world/america/190282/gerald-fitch-inks-with-piratas-de-quebradillas.html Gerald Fitch inks with Piratas de Quebradillas]</ref>

On January 12, 2017, he signed with [[San Lorenzo de Almagro (basketball)|San Lorenzo de Almagro]] of the [[Liga Nacional de Básquet]].<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/world/america/222931/gerald-fitch-signs-with-san-lorenzo-in-argentina.html Gerald Fitch signs with San Lorenzo in Argentina]</ref>

On March 14, 2017, he re-joined the Piratas de Quebradillas for the 2017 BSN season.<ref>[https://www.bsnpr.com/noticias/detalles.asp?r=13535#.WMlYT31tnDc Gerald Fitch regresa a Quebradillas] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181229032349/https://www.bsnpr.com/noticias/detalles.asp?r=13535#.WMlYT31tnDc |date=December 29, 2018 }} {{in lang|es}}</ref>

On January 28, 2018, he signed with [[Regatas Corrientes]].<ref>[https://www.basquetplus.com/articulo/gerald-fitch-es-el-nuevo-extranjero-de-regatas-corrientes Gerald Fitch es el nuevo extranjero de Regatas Corrientes] {{in lang|es}}</ref>
